newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CBD NZ seeks to raise NZ$19.5-29.5 mln via issue.
newsitem.headline: CBD NZ seeks to raise NZ$19.5-29.5 mln via issue.

text.p: Property investment company CBD New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday it was seeking to raise between NZ$19.5 million and $29.5 million, through the issue of ordinary shares to which free options will be attached.
The shares will be issued at NZ$1 each, with the options attached on a one for four basis.
Foundation shareholder Westpac Investment Management NZ Ltd will, on completion of the issue, hold 5.5 million fully paid $1 shares, equivalent to a 15.7 percent stake, the company said.
Public investors will hold 29.5 million fully paid shares, equivalent to 84.3 percent of issued shares, assuming the issue is fully subscribed, the firm added in a statement.
